name: Being Tired
overview: Scripture reveals that God provides strength and renewal to those who are weary, offering power to the faint and replenishment to sorrowful souls. Believers are encouraged to wait upon the Lord to experience renewed strength that enables them to persevere without fainting. Jesus invites all who are burdened to come to Him for rest, while the apostle Paul reminds us that through Christ's strength, we can endure and continue doing good without growing weary.
